title: Compute rank and characteristic polynomial over Q(i)

source.citation: Tuyen Trung Truong, Some approaches toward the Jacobian conjecture, arXiv:1503.08733

translation.notes: The paper's displayed 4-by-4 matrix is entered exactly over Q(i). Noether reproduces its rank and characteristic polynomial. This is a necessary source computation but does not claim the paper's radical-ideal certificate for Condition C1.
